'''Wind Wave''' is an [[Wind spells|air]]-based [[Wave spells|wave spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 62 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the second-strongest wind spell in the game, with the strongest being [[Wind Surge]]. It is also the most cost-effective wave spell to cast.

==Damage==
Wind Wave's base maximum hit starts at 17 and increases as the player unlocks additional wave spells, up to 20 at level 75 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Wind Wave's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an air-based spell, Wind Wave's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to air]].
